rawFindings.claim: auto_comment now posts a summary comment on every triaged issue, but triagePR (same pillar, same triageOpts source) never posts any comment, leaving the option's semantics inconsistent across the triage pillar
rawFindings.description: The change makes pillars.triage.auto_comment gate a summary comment for every successfully triaged ISSUE (packages/web/src/workers/triageWorker.js @HEAD lines 349-394). However, triagePR reads the same repoConfig.pillars.triage options (repoConfig fetched in triagePR, triageOpts = repoConfig.pillars?.triage) and only applies a size label — it contains no postMarkedComment call at all (verified by reading lines 438-630 of triageWorker.js at HEAD). This is pre-existing behavior rather than a regression introduced by this PR (triagePR never posted comments before either), but the PR's stated contract — 'auto_comment: post triage summary as comment' — is now honored on the issue path only. A repo enabling auto_comment gets comments on issues but never on PRs, which is a consistency gap in the config contract this PR is aligning code to. Worth either documenting that auto_comment applies to issue triage only, or filing as follow-up work.

proof.summary: Read triageWorker.js at HEAD: triageIssue lines 349-394 post a marker-backed comment whenever triageOpts.auto_comment !== false; triagePR (lines ~438-630) applies only a size label via octokit.request POST /labels and calls completeOperation without any postMarkedComment invocation.

rawFindings.claim: No test covers the 'blocked' ambiguous-marker outcome, which is now reachable on every triaged issue rather than only needs_more_info/duplicate cases
rawFindings.description: Before this PR the throw on result.action === 'blocked' (triageWorker.js @HEAD ~line 374-379) was only reachable when a needs_more_info/duplicate_hint comment had been posted. The change makes every triaged issue traverse postMarkedComment + the blocked-marker error path, so the blast radius of a marker ambiguity (e.g., a repo where a legacy duplicate triage comment exists) grows from rare classifications to all issues. The new test suite (triage-auto-comment.test.js) covers created/updated actions but not the blocked action, so the new guarantee 'an ambiguous marker is a blocking error' is untested for the now-default path. Low severity since the behavior is unchanged code, but coverage would be cheap to add.

proof.summary: Static read of HEAD: the blocked branch at lines ~374-379 throws on ambiguous markers; new tests only stub postMarkedComment resolving {action:'created'} or {action:'updated'}.
